issue_context.title: Wirelesstags does not produce uinique IDs and uses wrong "Id" to produce them
issue_context.body:
### The problem

The integraiton for Wireless Sensor Tags does not produce uniqueIDs when using multiple tag managers. It is using the slaveId (or tag_id) Instead the uuid should be used (tag.uuid). This is unique across all tag managers, vs the slaveid (in the code as tag_id) which is only the unique identifier on the tag manager.



### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

core-2023.8.0

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

core-2023.7.3

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant OS

### Integration causing the issue

wirelesstag

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/wirelesstag/

### Diagnostics information

_No response_

### Example YAML snippet

_No response_

### Anything in the logs that might be useful for us?

```txt
2023-08-03 18:42:40.033 ERROR (MainThread) [homeassistant.components.sensor] Platform wirelesstag does not generate unique IDs. ID 2_humidity is already used by sensor.wirelesstag_office_freezer_humidity - ignoring sensor.wirelesstag_shattic_north_humidity
2023-08-03 18:42:40.479 ERROR (MainThread) [homeassistant.components.sensor] Platform wirelesstag does not generate unique IDs. ID 2_light is already used by sensor.wirelesstag_office_freezer_light - ignoring sensor.wirelesstag_shattic_north_light
```


### Additional information

This completely breaks my setup since i have sensors across to tag managers. Basically half of them will no longer load due to this.

Just a note that if you change "self.tag_id" in the attr_unique_id property string to "self._uuid", across the 3 files it was changed in this release, it should fix it.

Also note that for anyone who already has run it with the tag_id, it will now create duplicates. I don't know if there is a way for HA to "update" the unique_ID instead of creating new entities with the new unique_id.

I copied the code into a custom component and made the necessary changes, but I had to delete a bunch of devices ad then also remove the _2 off a bunch of entity names so my device would work (I believe I also lost my history because of that, but oh well). So I know the "fix" works, but i'm not sure about doing PRs into HA core.
I am having the same issue... is anyone working on a fix? If so how can I implement it?

> I am having the same issue... is anyone working on a fix? If so how can I implement it?

I fixed it by copying the code from the integration (all the files) into the "custom_integration" folder in your config directory and then changing the lines that had 

`self._attr_unique_id = f"{self.tag_id}_{self._sensor_type}`

to

`self._attr_unique_id = f"{self._uuid}_{self._sensor_type}"`

it's a messy way to fix it, and when you do it, since some of your tags already have Unique_IDs they will be abandoned when it gets new IDs so you lost history.

you have to make sure you set a version in the manifest.json othewise it won't override. I don't' think the original Dev has any activity since early last year. I'm busy at work, but when I free up some  I can look at making the changes and putting in a PR for the HA team to consider.

> @sirmeili, sorry for the dumb question, but I don't seem to have a "custom_integration" in my config directory. Could it be located somewhere else? Thank you... I have nearly 40 tags I am monitoring(Ughhhhh!)

My bad. It's "custom_components"

this is what my structure looks like

@keith-frank , yeah, you have to add the wirelesstag folder and then copy the files from the repo here (you'll see I have 5) and then modify them as I stated above.

And ensure to add the version to the manifest.json file. this is what I have (added version and didn't make any other changes)

    "version": "1.0.0"
  }`
